doctrine: Strategic rebrand and revenue plan for full-time engineer who shoots photography 10-15 hrs/week. Core diagnosis: systems work but story is invisible. Rebrand voice is Calm Authority (educated, structured, execution-focused, human). Revenue architecture: (1) Increase prices to $2,000-2,500 floor except $350 floor offer; (2) Content retainer at $1,500-2,000/month (one 2-hour session/month per client) as highest-leverage offer; (3) Gallery upsells at $40-50 each; (4) New customer acquisition. Month 3-6 revenue target $4,900-11,000/month. Book ($19-25 Gumroad) positions as credibility asset leading to session, then retainer. Weekly execution: 2.5 hrs outreach (Instantly, LinkedIn 3-5 comments), 2.5 hrs content (3x/week posts), 1.25 hrs admin, 3-5 hrs weekend shoots, 1-2 hrs book/systems. Content approach shifts from B2B niche to Identity model: people follow story, photography is vehicle. Content calendar: Monday LinkedIn (value/authority), Wednesday Instagram (journey/BTS), Friday/Saturday Instagram (portfolio/offer). Content multiplication: one shoot yields portfolio post, BTS video, LinkedIn insight, Kling AI motion version. Book launch is 4-week sequence. Network plays: Alandria (2.3M followers) creative shoot swap, Amberlin collab showing 2020-to-158K evolution, internal company headshots/team photos, mentor cross-marketing, affiliate nodes (wedding planners/event coords/real estate/marketing agencies). Timeline: Month 1 (April) rebrand rollout, Gumroad live, door-walk Eagle Rock, negotiate studio deal. Month 2 (May) book launch, first retainer pitch, Alandria concept pitched. Month 3 (June) first retainer signed, $3-5K target. Month 6 (Sept) two retainers, 2-3 bookings/month, $4-8K/month target. Month 12 (March 2027) inbound matches outbound, choosing work not chasing. Stop: perfect content with no human, channel-agnostic posting, hiding personality, ignoring seasonal demand, unused celebrity connections. Start: real story in Calm Authority voice, tag book/engineering/studio as brand, track upsell revenue, pitch retainer after every delivery, network swaps, seasonal calendar (graduation May, weddings Jun-Oct, holidays Nov-Dec). Keep: OG chat operations, pricing structure, Instantly campaigns, Lightroom+Evoto pipeline, Pixieset, 3x/week cadence, Google Business posting. Immediate next 15 minutes: text Pearl, text Davis, open Gumroad.
